findings.title: Quoted duplicate keys evade uniqueness validation
findings.mechanism: Only bare key spellings are counted; quoted duplicate identities/descriptions are ignored.
findings.impact: Internal build/verify can accept native metadata with duplicate semantic keys and differing identity/description.
findings.repair: Reject unsupported key syntax or normalize supported keys before duplicate checking; add mixed quoted/bare duplicate real-build fixtures.

findings.title: Plain fallback and unconsumed structure do not fail closed
findings.mechanism: 0x10 and colon-space plain values evade the scalar rejection list; quoted branches return without validating trailing indentation.
findings.impact: A verified portable pack can contain non-string or invalid native metadata despite the stated conservative contract.
findings.repair: Constrain supported plain grammar and validate complete scalar/header structure consistently; add real-build rejection cases while preserving current portable positives.

executedChecks.evidence: 12 rejection and 7 positive fixtures execute buildProduct in isolated temporary packs; positives also verifyProduct. Additional finding examples are static traces, not executed cases.
